name: ShowSky_9
short_caption: The robot raises its right hand high into the air with an open palm to point upwards, then returns to neutral.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises its right arm up and outward, extending it fully above its head with an open palm facing forward. The head subtly tilts upward to track the gesture, holding the high pointing pose for about two seconds. Finally, the robot lowers its arm smoothly back down to its side, returning to its neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The right arm extends fully upward and outward; ensure there are no overhead or lateral obstructions close to the robot's right side.
